archetypes.name: dyn-scope-gate
archetypes.rationale: Remote PR mutation gates now span implement scope artifacts and low-level gh helpers.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the changed PR mutation gate paths in python/larch/implement/scope_disposition.py, python/larch/git/pr.py, and python/larch/git/gh.py. Focus on whether every push, PR create, and body edit path validates scope disposition before mutation without breaking non-implement callers. Check fail-closed behavior for missing, malformed, stale, or manifest-only artifacts, and verify NeedsUserInput routing stays distinct from generic errors. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
